description: Your life is your responsibility! No one else’s #selflove #responsibility
transcript: Don't bring something to me thinking that I am going to convince you to do something else. Not ready, you're not ready. I am not accountable for anyone else's life. If you don't want to go left, don't go left. Not have the background information that you do for your life. So I cannot make conscious decisions for you. It is our responsibility to reassess, restructure, remove, and reevaluate.
